posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Since the topic of costumes has come up various times as of late in the podcast and streams, what are your thoughts on the various outfits our heroes and villains wear in the Sentinelsverse?

A few of the ones I particularly like:

I love that they came up with a way for Legacy to look patriotic without the same stars n' stripes motif most America patriotic characters wear. The idea of using Paul Revere's lantern is both unique and goes with Legacy's gift for leadership and hope.

I also love Grandpa Legacy's superheroic WWII uniform look.

Super-Scientific Tachyon's outfit makes her look like a true adventurer scientist.

Scholar of the Infinite also has a very sharply stylish adventuring look to him.

Captain Cosmic's Prime Wardens style makes him look like we should call him Admiral Cosmic. Love that snappy jacket.

I feel like in Tactics Argent Adept's finally found an outfit that's just the right combo of stylized and practical; love the scarf especially. Also it gives him a sort of desert adventurer look.

Over on the villains side, I want to shop wherever Matriarch shops for clothes. I've always loved the classy Goth look.

Baron Blade looks great in the RPG. Like the platonic ideal of an aristocratic mad scientist.

And The Operative looks gorgeous in her green/blue minidress getup in Tactics.

I'm a little bit disappointed they didn't put all the XPWs in leather jackets to go with how everyone in the Avengers had a leather jacket back then. Though Fanatic has Psylocke's swimsuit, Argent is doing the "uncomfortable metal clothes" trope, and Cosmic has the mullet and all the guns.

Gotta love XPW Argent's manly hair, too. Speaking of hair, I always wish I had Parse's hair any time I see her portrait.

posts.name: Ehkrickor
posts.cooked:
Definately like the PW co-ordination, the Red/gold shot through the whole ensamble creates a nice aggressive but team oriented undertone while still allowing a lot of individuality to show through with unique secondary colors & contrasting skin tones.

I think that the wardens have really stepped it up with the XPW costumes though, The retro 90's look, so hot right now. Tempest gets extra points though, with 4 heroes in Metalic bodysuits shot through with gold and silver having, to use a comedy term, a "straight-man" to play off brings the whole grouping together & makes it pop so much more. Then again CC has always had Fantastic fasion sense. a Double breasted jacked whatever the material screams poise & is particularly well made in the cold of a vacuum.

Nightmist is another Hero Fashion star in her short Skirt & Loong jacket which always pairs very well particularly when offset by going to opposite ends of the pallet for any accompanying garments.

And finally my last pick for "Killing it" with their new costumes is Harpy, the short coctail dress and boots pairs suprisingly well with the renaisaunce style half cape and mask, beautifully offset by the distressed look of her torn fishnets. Overall a very nice ensamble that is sure to see immitations around Rook City's rather ... antagonistic night clubs. 

(what do you guys think. Too deep into the "fashion critic" character?)
